definition.predictor: frozen in-context classifier (query batch + demonstration tokens)
definition.m: mean_i CE_i(f_A, y_i) - CE_i(f_{A u {j}}, y_i)
definition.bound: first - 0.25 * d_squared <= m <= first (softmax-CE Hessian 0 <= H <= 0.5 I)
definition.aggregate_rows: one row per (state, candidate); the aggregate bound uses mean_i ||d_i||^2 (Jensen); the mean-logit variant uses ||mean_i d_i||^2
